description: Change a direct fee row; only the fields sent change. Read the current value with its read tool first; this call returns the value as it now stands.

amount.description: EUR, or a percent when amount_is_percentage.

calculation_type.description: How it is collected: `separate_payment` paid at the base (default), `advance_payment` charged at booking, `included_in_price`.

description.description: The fee as guests read it.

percentage_base.description: What the percentage is taken on; empty is the charter price.

period.description: How it is counted, per booking, day, night, person or week; the answer to a wrong value lists the allowed ones.

required.description: true when every guest pays it.

name: update_fee
